summary_zh: 這裡教授英文發音技巧，幫助你改善口音，說出更道地的英語。

vocabulary.example: Your pronunciation has improved a lot.
He speaks with a British accent.
Pay attention to the intonation pattern.

example_sentences.en: The 'th' sound is made by placing your tongue between your teeth.
example_sentences.zh: 發『th』音時要把舌頭放在牙齒之間。

example_sentences.en: Stress the first syllable: PHO-to-graph, but pho-TO-gra-pher.

teaching_tip: 發音教學應從最小對比(minimal pairs)入手，讓學生先聽懂區別，再模仿產出。錄下自己的聲音對比原音是很有效的方法。
